attributes.description: Traffic, bandwidth, and rejected flows for AWS VPC Flow Logs queried from the vpc_flow FDS dataset.

embeddableConfig.content: ## ![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)  \[AWS VPC FDS\] VPC Flow Logs Overview

query.esql: FROM vpc_flow | KEEP @timestamp, action | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND action != "-" | STATS `Total Flows` = COUNT(*)
FROM vpc_flow | KEEP @timestamp, action | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND action != "-" | STATS `Total Flows` = COUNT(*)

embeddableConfig.description: Total number of VPC flow log records in the selected time range

query.esql: FROM vpc_flow | KEEP @timestamp, action | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND action == "ACCEPT" | STATS `Accepted` = COUNT(*)
FROM vpc_flow | KEEP @timestamp, action | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND action == "ACCEPT" | STATS `Accepted` = COUNT(*)

embeddableConfig.description: Number of flows allowed by security group and network ACL rules

query.esql: FROM vpc_flow | KEEP @timestamp, action | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND action == "REJECT" | STATS `Rejected` = COUNT(*)
FROM vpc_flow | KEEP @timestamp, action | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND action == "REJECT" | STATS `Rejected` = COUNT(*)

embeddableConfig.description: Number of flows denied by security group or network ACL rules

query.esql: FROM vpc_flow | KEEP @timestamp, action | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND action IN ("ACCEPT", "REJECT") | STATS total = COUNT(*), rejected = COUNT(action == "REJECT" OR NULL) | EVAL `Reject Rate %` = ROUND(rejected * 100.0 / total, 1) | KEEP `Reject Rate %`

FROM vpc_flow | KEEP @timestamp, action | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND action IN ("ACCEPT", "REJECT") | STATS total = COUNT(*), rejected = COUNT(action == "REJECT" OR NULL) | EVAL `Reject Rate %` = ROUND(rejected * 100.0 / total, 1) | KEEP `Reject Rate %`

embeddableConfig.description: Percentage of flows rejected out of total

query.esql: FROM vpc_flow | KEEP @timestamp, bytes | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend | STATS `Total Bytes` = SUM(bytes)
FROM vpc_flow | KEEP @timestamp, bytes | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend | STATS `Total Bytes` = SUM(bytes)

embeddableConfig.description: Total bytes transferred across all flows in the selected time range

query.esql: FROM vpc_flow | KEEP @timestamp, srcaddr | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND srcaddr != "-" | STATS `Source IPs` = COUNT_DISTINCT(srcaddr)
FROM vpc_flow | KEEP @timestamp, srcaddr | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND srcaddr != "-" | STATS `Source IPs` = COUNT_DISTINCT(srcaddr)
FROM vpc_flow | KEEP @timestamp, dstaddr | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND dstaddr != "-" | STATS `Dest IPs` = COUNT_DISTINCT(dstaddr)
FROM vpc_flow | KEEP @timestamp, dstaddr | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND dstaddr != "-" | STATS `Dest IPs` = COUNT_DISTINCT(dstaddr)

embeddableConfig.description: Count of unique destination IP addresses contacted.

query.esql: FROM vpc_flow | KEEP @timestamp, interface_id | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend | STATS `Interfaces` = COUNT_DISTINCT(interface_id)
FROM vpc_flow | KEEP @timestamp, interface_id | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend | STATS `Interfaces` = COUNT_DISTINCT(interface_id)

embeddableConfig.description: Count of unique Elastic Network Interfaces (ENIs) with recorded flow activity in the selected time range.

query.esql: FROM vpc_flow | KEEP @timestamp, action | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND action != "-" | EVAL act = action | STATS count = COUNT(*) BY act
FROM vpc_flow | KEEP @timestamp, action | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND action != "-" | EVAL act = action | STATS count = COUNT(*) BY act

FROM vpc_flow | KEEP @timestamp, dstport | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND dstport > 0 | EVAL port = TO_STRING(dstport) | STATS count = COUNT(*) BY port | SORT count DESC | LIMIT 10

FROM vpc_flow | KEEP @timestamp, dstport | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND dstport > 0 | EVAL port = TO_STRING(dstport) | STATS count = COUNT(*) BY port | SORT count DESC | LIMIT 10

FROM vpc_flow | KEEP @timestamp, protocol, action | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND protocol IS NOT NULL AND action != "-" | EVAL proto = CASE(protocol == 6, "TCP", protocol == 17, "UDP", protocol == 1, "ICMP", TO_STRING(protocol)) | STATS count = COUNT(*) BY proto | SORT count DESC

FROM vpc_flow | KEEP @timestamp, protocol, action | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND protocol IS NOT NULL AND action != "-" | EVAL proto = CASE(protocol == 6, "TCP", protocol == 17, "UDP", protocol == 1, "ICMP", TO_STRING(protocol)) | STATS count = COUNT(*) BY proto | SORT count DESC

FROM vpc_flow | KEEP @timestamp, action | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND action != "-" | EVAL act = action | STATS count = COUNT(*) BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 100, ?_tstart, ?_tend), act | SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM vpc_flow | KEEP @timestamp, action | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND action != "-" | EVAL act = action | STATS count = COUNT(*) BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 100, ?_tstart, ?_tend), act | SORT time_bucket ASC
FROM vpc_flow | KEEP @timestamp, srcaddr | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND srcaddr != "-" | EVAL src = srcaddr | STATS count = COUNT(*) BY src | SORT count DESC | LIMIT 10
FROM vpc_flow | KEEP @timestamp, srcaddr | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND srcaddr != "-" | EVAL src = srcaddr | STATS count = COUNT(*) BY src | SORT count DESC | LIMIT 10

FROM vpc_flow | KEEP @timestamp, bytes | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend | STATS total_bytes = SUM(bytes) BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 100, ?_tstart, ?_tend) | SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM vpc_flow | KEEP @timestamp, bytes | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend | STATS total_bytes = SUM(bytes) BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 100, ?_tstart, ?_tend) | SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM vpc_flow | KEEP @timestamp, dstport, action | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND action == "REJECT" AND dstport > 0 | EVAL port = TO_STRING(dstport) | STATS count = COUNT(*) BY port | SORT count DESC | LIMIT 10

FROM vpc_flow | KEEP @timestamp, dstport, action | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND action == "REJECT" AND dstport > 0 | EVAL port = TO_STRING(dstport) | STATS count = COUNT(*) BY port | SORT count DESC | LIMIT 10

FROM vpc_flow
| KEEP @timestamp, srcaddr, dstaddr, srcport, dstport, protocol, packets, bytes, action, interface_id
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| EVAL `Protocol` = CASE(protocol == 6, "TCP", protocol == 17, "UDP", protocol == 1, "ICMP", TO_STRING(protocol))
| KEEP @timestamp, action, srcaddr, srcport, dstaddr, dstport, `Protocol`, packets, bytes, interface_id
| RENAME action AS `Action`,
         srcaddr AS `Source IP`,
         srcport AS `Src Port`,
         dstaddr AS `Dest IP`,
         dstport AS `Dst Port`,
         packets AS `Packets`,
         bytes AS `Bytes`,
         interface_id AS `ENI`
| SORT @timestamp DESC

FROM vpc_flow
| KEEP @timestamp, srcaddr, dstaddr, srcport, dstport, protocol, packets, bytes, action, interface_id
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| EVAL `Protocol` = CASE(protocol == 6, "TCP", protocol == 17, "UDP", protocol == 1, "ICMP", TO_STRING(protocol))
| KEEP @timestamp, action, srcaddr, srcport, dstaddr, dstport, `Protocol`, packets, bytes, interface_id
| RENAME action AS `Action`,
         srcaddr AS `Source IP`,
         srcport AS `Src Port`,
         dstaddr AS `Dest IP`,
         dstport AS `Dst Port`,
         packets AS `Packets`,
         bytes AS `Bytes`,
         interface_id AS `ENI`
| SORT @timestamp DESC
